ios.desc:
Firmament is a calm one-touch rocket arcade game about timing, gravity, and recovery.

Hold to thrust. Release to drift, fall, and build speed. Then fire the engine again to catch the rocket and turn a dangerous dive into a clean arc.

Every short run asks you to read the sky, manage fuel, weave through soft cloud hazards, and decide whether nearby coins are worth leaving the safer route.

PUSH THE LIMIT HIGHER

The Firmament is a visible cloud-bank limit. You cannot cross it, but a strong climb can push it higher and raise your altitude record.

UNLOCK NEW WAYS TO FLY

Collect coins and unlock ships with different strengths: larger fuel tanks, higher speed, softer cloud impacts, or stronger pickup reach.

FLY A DIFFERENT PLAN EACH DAY

Daily challenges reward more than distance. Stay low, chase altitude, skim the ground, collect fuel first, or take a route you would normally avoid.

• Simple one-touch controls
• Short, replayable flights
• Fuel routes, coin risks, and cloud pressure
• Unlockable ships with distinct strengths
• Daily challenges
• Game Center leaderboards

How far can you fly—and how high can you push the limit?
